description: Top-level definitions run in order as nested lets: a def named _ runs for its effect, a defn sees only the names before it, and a later def of the same name shadows.
program:
(def a (call store.get {:id "a"}))
(def n (get a :size))
(defn bump [x] (+ x n))
(def n "later")
(def _ (call store.put {:id n :size (bump 1)}))
(bump 10)
